state:
**Goal `ldap`, Stage 10 (the feature proofs) is under way.** Stages 1 to 5 and 7 to 9 are done; Stage 4 lacks only a CA a program supplies, and Stage 6 lacks only wiring the schema into the readers. `modify`, `delete`, `rename`, `setPassword`, `changePassword`, `compare` and `Entry::isDeleted` owe nothing, perf included.

**Eleven `Core\Ldap` features still owe everything.** `bun nv proofs --owed --limit 1000 | grep -i ldap` lists them: `Connection::whoami`, `authenticate`, `search`, `changes`, `read` and `add` (about, examples, hostile, perf, tests), `LdapError` (about, examples, hostile, tests), and the enums `ErrorKind`, `Tls`, `Scope` and `Ad\AccountType` (about, examples, tests). `bun nv proofs --gate` prints only its first 30 lines, so read the full list there and never the driver's one-line summary.

**The whole-roster check also counts features outside this goal.** `bun nv proofs --gate` says 164 of 1390 owe a proof, and most are `Core\Str` stale perf, `lang` and `Core\Db`. The check `dossier-the-whole-roster-owes-nothing-with-core-ldap` in `data/goals/ldap.json` cannot pass from `Core\Ldap` work alone.

**Two blocks reach `samba-ad`.** `[ldap.corp]` binds as the read-only `Reader` and is granted by directory to every `Ldap-*` tree. `[ldap.corp-accounts]` binds as `Administrator` and is granted only to the write proofs' directories and bench files, by a nested `[[app]] root` or `entry` in the root `nvs.toml`. `add` writes, so its proofs need `corp-accounts` grants beside the `modify` ones; `authenticate` binds on a fresh connection. An `[[app]] root` that names a missing directory fails every program with `E0605`. Check a draft with `bun nv proofs --run --id '<feature>' --show`.

**Samba stalls under parallel writes.** A write bench run beside a write attack can hit the block's 5 s timeout; `--record-perf --only <id>` alone succeeds. `delete`'s bench is 100 rounds for that reason. A delete of an entry with entries below it throws `LdapError` with `$kind` `Protocol` (result 66).

**Seeded facts a proof can print:** people are `CN=Anna Berg`, `CN=Ben Kohl`, `CN=Carla Diaz` and `CN=Dora Lind` under `OU=Company`, plus `CN=Reader`.

items.text: **`Core\Ldap\Connection::whoami` owes nothing** (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`): its row is at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/registry.rs:405`. `tests/conformance/core/ldap-whoami-takes-no-arguments.nvst:1` and `ldap-whoami-is-the-same-over-a-granted-cleartext-bind.nvst` need a `// covers:` marker, and a Rust test in `crates/nvs-stdlib/tests/ldap.rs:2166` needs one too. It reads, so its proofs use `[ldap.corp]`.

**`Core\Ldap\Connection::read` owes nothing** (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`): its row is at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/registry.rs:447`; `tests/conformance/core/ldap-read-and-search-take-a-dn.nvst:1` takes a `// covers:` marker.

**`Core\Ldap\Connection::add` owes nothing** (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`): its row is at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/registry.rs:456`; `tests/conformance/core/ldap-add-modify-delete-rename.nvst:4` takes `add` beside its `modify` and `delete` marker, and the proofs need `corp-accounts` grants beside the `modify` ones in the root `nvs.toml`.

backlog: `search`, `changes` and `authenticate` owe every proof — the group after this one (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`).
`LdapError`, `ErrorKind`, `Tls`, `Scope` and `Ad\AccountType` owe about, examples and tests (`data/proofs/policy.json` says what an enum owes).
The whole-roster check owes features outside `Core\Ldap`; whether `data/goals/ldap.json` should narrow it to `--group 'Core\Ldap'` is the goal record's question.
A non-leaf delete reports `$kind` `Protocol`; whether result 66 deserves a named kind is `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/registry.rs`'s `ERROR_KIND`.
`bun nv verify`'s conformance store kept 89 cases red with no keys last time (`tools/nv/select/record.ts`); this session's verify was green.
